plan.english: Father Sky, hear our word. And then you placed our deep springs. You slew the serpent; the waters came forth. You are the giver of good things. You know us, and you love us. Who then gave us the rain? And he is famous Sky. Then the earth drank the sweet water. We sing your famous name. Bring us strength and increase. Now remember us; may our work succeed.

The rain-cloud came from the sky; it rained upon the grain. It grew, and the springs became full. The gods saw the rain, and they became joyful. He who rained upon the earth is Father Sky. He fills the springs; he fills the sea. And now may our cattle become strong. Lead them to the sweet water. May they drink; may they be sated.

Dawn, daughter of Sky, you grew bright. Then Night went away, and the stars vanished. Carrying the light, Dawn lit up the path. And the sun follows her. She stretches her wings. Her light is sweet. Night is her sister. Dawn, when you come to us, the men wake. Red Dawn, show us the path. Now remember our brothers. We sing your great fame.

Who has seen Dawn? I have seen her, the daughter of Sky. She wears a red garment; she lifts the light. And then she leads our sun. And now, Dawn, go to us. Bring us strength; lead us to the light. And now, Dawn, do not leave us. She is swift, and she is alert. Dawn, you are not mortal.

The sun lights up the earth. It sees the paths of men. And it is strong. When it comes, the dew melts. It gives light to the gods. And now the wheel of the sun goes. And the gods are turned toward it. And now, Sun, listen to us. It warms us, and it nourishes us. Now make our path straight.

Who set the wheel of the imperishable sun? And strong Sky indeed set it. The two swift horses carry it. And the gods see it. It is strong; it is swift. Now let us sing the wheel of the sun. It is turned toward us; it is not mortal. And now protect us with it.

Fire, you are born in the water. You eat the branches; you warm us. You are the giver of good things. Now convey our song to the gods. Whoever sings to you, him you love. And now may we walk to you. You are strong, and you are swift. And you are not mortal. Hear us, and do not leave us.

Now fire lies in the branches. The man seized the branch; fire came forth. Fire, you heat the water. And this branch burns. And then you cook the lamb. You are our brother; you are our parent. We sat down by Fire, and we gave him a branch. Listening to our word, Fire grew bright. And now may it not vanish.

Waters, you are mothers. You fill the sea, and it is deep. The water carries the load. And our spring is full. Lead us to the sweet water. And now may you protect us. Waters, may we not thirst. And let us walk to you. He who drinks the water is joyful.

Now this deep earth was thirsty. The serpent seized the waters, and they did not come forth. And then our god slew the serpent. Then the waters came forth, and they went to the sea. The earth drank, and became green. Him who slew the serpent we sing. Then great fame came to him. God, keep us from it. And now may the water go to us.

Mother Earth, you bear the load. You carry us; you nourish us. The seed grew in the earth, and it became strong. The rain-cloud rains; you drink the sweet water. You are the mother of the gods; now hear us. We sip at your breast. Give us flour and great strength. And may your field be productive.

title: Earth the Giver of Good Things

plan.english: Earth, you nourish the sheep. The sweet dew lies on your field. The hedge is green. The sun warms the dew, and the grain grows. And who nourishes us? And she nourishes us. She is the giver of good things. He who ploughs eats. And now may your seed become strong. She loves us; remember us.

title: Sky and Earth, Parents of the Gods

plan.english: Sky and Earth are the parents of the gods. Sky is the father; Earth is the mother. From famous Sky and Earth the gods are born. They are strong; they are famous. Father Sky and Mother Earth, hear us. And they are alert. Now give us increase. They love us; now may our cattle increase.

title: Hymn to Night and the Stars

plan.english: Night arrived, and the stars flashed up. Who creates your stars? And our god creates them. They keep us, and they are alert. Night, sister of Dawn, lead us. And now do not give us to the wolf. May the night vanish, and may Dawn come.

The gods gave the sun a famous name. Then they gave Dawn a famous name. The gods are givers of good things. Who knows the names of the gods? And now we know them. Gods, listen to us, and keep us. The gods are not mortal. And let us walk to you. Now may the gods not leave us.

Rain-cloud, you came from the sky, and you rained upon the earth. The earth drank, and the springs became full. And then this sea became full of water. Whoever drinks your water becomes joyful. And now convey the water to us. May the seed increase, and may the gods be glad. The rain-cloud is swift; now we sing to you.

The wheel of the sun sank into the sea, and night arrived. And then our great stars stood up. The fire woke; the fire burns. We sat down by the fire, and we ate the lamb. It grows dark, and Fire is awake. And who then will lead it? And then Dawn will lead it.

Red Dawn, the daughter of Sky, arrived. And then strong Fire woke. Fire, you are alert, and you warm us. You drive away grief; you are strong. We bring you a lamb; you eat it. Show us your light. We trust in you; you love us. And now may he remember us.

Red Dawn is the daughter of the sun. Famous Dawn arrived, and then the sun arrived. And then it lit up the water. Great daughter of the sun, you are red. Dawn, you are our sister. And now, Dawn, listen to us. And now, Dawn, do not leave us. And she is turned toward us. She knows us, and she loves us. And may we trust in you.

title: Father Sky, Source of the Gods

plan.english: Father Sky, you are great. And from you Dawn is born. From you the gods are born; from you the rain comes. Your name is famous. And now, Sky, you hear us. And then, Father, you placed our stars. We bring you a famous sweet song. And Sky, you are turned toward us. May we walk in your light.

title: Prayer to Father Sky for Cattle and Fame

plan.english: Father Sky, I bring you this song. Giver of good things, hear my word. I milked the cattle for you; then you gave cattle to my parents. And now give me cattle and offspring. Make my path straight. Give me imperishable fame. And now may I live in the imperishable light. Him who speaks to you, you protect. My parents spoke to you, and I speak to you. And Father, do not leave me.

Dawn, daughter of Sky, we speak to you. When you come, Dawn, your cattle stand up. Drive the red cattle to us. Bring us strength and increase. Show us the path. Give us imperishable fame. Protect us with your light. I lift my song to you. And we trust in you. May we come to know you; do not leave us.

Sun, you light up the earth. The two swift horses carry the wheel of the sun. Hear me, and remember me. Whoever speaks to you, give him light. May I see your light. Now may my cattle not tremble. My brothers know you. And now may my work succeed; I trust in you.

title: Prayer to Fire with a Lamb

plan.english: Swift Fire, I bring you a lamb. And then, Fire, eat it. Convey my word to the gods. My parents gave you branches. And now I give you branches. Whoever gives to you, give him cattle. Give me imperishable fame. I trust in you; now may my fire not vanish.

title: Prayer to Fire against the Wolf

plan.english: Fire, you are alert; the wolf creeps toward us. Now protect my sheep from the wolf. And now drive him away from us. You know my word; I spoke to you, and you heard me. May my sheep and my horses live. And you are not mortal. And now do not burn my hedge.

Waters, listen to me. My cattle and my sheep are thirsty. Come to us; give us water. Carry my song to the gods. May my cattle drink; may they be satisfied. Give me strength; I will sing to you. I milked your cattle for you; now remember me.

title: Prayer to Mother Earth for Grain

plan.english: Mother Earth, you nourish men and cattle. I plough the field; you give me grain. And now listen to my word. And now whoever ploughs, him you nourish. Now give me offspring. We sip at your breast. And now may my offspring grow. And now may the dew lie on the hedge.

Father Sky, my cattle are thirsty. Then you rained upon the fields of my parents. The springs became full; the sheep became joyful. And now rain upon my grain. Give water to my cattle. I bring you a song; listen to it. May I come to know you; then I will sing to you.

Dawn, daughter of Sky, I see you. You are red; you are great. Dawn, when you come to us, the men wake. And then the strong horses stand up. My parents sang to you. You gave them imperishable fame. And give me cattle. Your garment is red. Do not leave me; now may I see you in the light.

title: Prayer to the Sun and its Wheel

plan.english: Sun, I see your wheel. And then Sky set the wheel of the sun. When you came, the dew melted. Hear my song, and look upon my cattle. Now make my path straight. May my offspring live in your light. Sun, you are not mortal. And now, Sun, remember me.

Great Mother Earth, hear me. Then you bore me, and you love me. You are the giver of good things. The seed lies in your field. And now, good seed, grow. And now give me strength. Give me offspring. Give me imperishable fame. And you are not mortal. May I come to know you; I trust in you, Earth.

Fire, you are my brother. You know my word, and I seek offspring. And now give me offspring. And now may they live in the light. May they become strong; may they speak your name. Protect me, and protect my brother. I trust in you. Give me cattle, Fire, giver of good things.

It grows dark, and the wolf creeps. Wolf, do not devour our sheep. And now do not seize this lamb. The dog sees you, and he tracks you. Go away from us; lie down away from us. May our sheep live; may you not devour them. Whoever devours the lamb, may he vanish. Wolf, go away.

Serpent, lie down; do not creep to us. Then Sky slew the serpent; he slew you. Do not enter our field; do not seize us. And now Fire will burn you. May the serpent vanish; go away from us. And now may we walk in the imperishable light.

Whoever drives away our cattle, may he be afraid. Whoever seized the cattle, may Fire burn him. And do not drive them away. Dog, track him; swift Fire is alert. Go away from us; may he tremble. And now may our cattle increase.

Locusts, do not eat up our seed. The locusts tremble, and they go away from us. Go to the sea; now Fire will burn you. It lies in the earth, and it grows. May it become grain; may it rain upon our field. And these locusts are afraid. Locusts, do not eat up our seed.

Now, grief, go away from our man. And now, grief, lie down in the earth. May he stand up, and may he live. Then the dew melted, and the grief vanished. May he be sated; may the water carry the grief to the sea. Grief is not strong. And now, grief, go away from him.

Fire, do not burn the man. Now do not burn our lambs. And now do not burn our hedge. Fire is born in the water. And now go to the deep water. And now, water, go to him. Water, cover him; the water is deep. May he become strong, and may the grain increase.

title: Charm against Fear in the Night

plan.english: Good brother, do not be afraid; sister, do not tremble. Fire is awake, and the dog is awake. Night will go away, and the sun will come. And then this dew will melt. May you live in this light. Sister, may you be sated; sister, do not be afraid. And now, brother, do not be afraid.

Now, dog, be awake, and, dog, protect our horses. Kill the swift wolf; they lie down. And now may he not come to us. And now may he not see them. Whoever guards the horses, may Fire guard him. And may they increase. Now, dog, be awake, and, dog, protect our horses.
